meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

copy.tagline: 通过 signal-cli 设备链接添加 Signal 频道集成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将 Signal 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.tagline_en: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Signal channels into your application

howto.what: NanoClaw 会新增 Signal 消息渠道:安装 signal-cli,把现有手机号作为辅助设备关联(不新开号码),终端显示二维码供扫码;关联后助手以该号码收发 Signal 消息,并保存账号供启动时使用。
howto.when: 当你说“添加 Signal”“接入 Signal”等,或要求把 NanoClaw 连接到 Signal 时,会进入配置流程。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 接入 Signal,用我的手机号扫码关联
say.note: 会安装 signal-cli 并显示关联二维码。

say.text: 帮我添加 Signal 消息渠道
say.note: 会复制适配器并注册到代码里。

say.text: 我想在 Signal 里跟助手聊天
say.note: 完成设备关联后即可通过 Signal 收发消息。

howto.what_en: NanoClaw gains a Signal message channel: it installs signal-cli, links your existing phone number as a secondary device (no new number), shows a QR to scan, then sends/receives Signal messages as that number and persists the account for startup.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add or connect a Signal channel, e.g. “add Signal” or “link Signal to NanoClaw”.

say_en.text: Add a Signal channel to NanoClaw and link it with my phone number.
say_en.note: Runs setup and shows a QR code to scan.

say_en.text: Set up Signal so I can message the assistant there.
say_en.note: Walks through device-linking and account wiring.

say_en.text: Connect my Signal account to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Installs and registers the Signal adapter.
